summary.one_liner: A curated, link-heavy guide to marketing practical software products (user research, content, influencer, Product Hunt, social media, email, and pricing), written by the founders of an iOS app.
summary.what_it_does: This is an "awesome"-style list of articles, videos, podcasts, spreadsheets and tools rather than code. It is organized as a table of contents of marketing categories: User Research, Market Research, Marketing without Budget, Content Marketing (personal blog, Medium, content promotion), Influencer Marketing, Product Hunt launch, Social Media Marketing (Twitter, Facebook, Reddit, LinkedIn, Quora), Lifecycle and Cold Email, Partnerships, Psychology, Business Model and Pricing, Marketing Automation, and SaaS model. Each section gives short commentary on the linked resources and sometimes names free or paid tools. The README is written from the perspective of Flawless App founders, who share their own experience in places. The section list also says Instagram and some subsections are "coming soon", and the README is truncated in the source, so not every listed category was visible to this summary.
use_cases: Finding beta testers for a new app
Getting first users without a marketing budget
Planning content marketing and blog SEO
Running Facebook or Reddit ads on a small budget
notable: Organized by marketing channel with a table of contents and per-section overviews
Heavy focus on bootstrapped, zero-budget channel tactics for indie and engineering-led products
Includes a dedicated Product Hunt launch section with tool suggestions
Written from the founders' own experience launching an iOS app
caveats: Mostly links to third-party articles, so many resources may be dated (several are from 2016 to 2017) or removed
Some sections are marked 'coming soon' or are incomplete, and the README is truncated
Not a software tool; there is nothing to install or run
